nome_articolo: First4Figures Cowboy Bebop Spike Spiegel 1/8 Resin (Statua)
descrizione:
First 4 Figures is proud to present its latest 1/8th scale collectible resin statue, Spike Spiegel.
Spike Spiegel is a bounty hunter known for his casual charm, sarcastic wit, and unparalleled mastery of martial arts and weapons. Beneath his seemingly indifferent demeanor lies a complex past, giving him a cold yet tragic presence.
This high-quality 1/8th scale resin statue depicts Spike Spiegel in a relaxed pose, a cigarette in his right hand and his suit jacket draped casually over his left shoulder. The statue faithfully captures Spike's distinctive appearance, including his tousled hair, blue suit with a yellow shirt, and his tall, slender figure. The base features a meticulously crafted abstract design, perfectly echoing the iconic art style of the Cowboy Bebop opening credits.

nome_articolo: Bandai Saint Cloth Myth Ex Epsilon Alioth Fenrir (Action Figure)

nome_articolo: Prime 1 Studio Throne Legacy God of War Series 1/3 Ragnarok Master Thyself Kratos (Statua)
descrizione:
Peace. Hope. Past and present, now as one.
Nine Realms' Mastered God of War, on the throne in 1/3 scale

Facing the end of the world and journeying across the vast Nine Realms, ""God of War Ragnarök"" stands as one of the series' defining milestones. From this action-adventure comes Master Thyself Kratos, joining the Throne Legacy lineup.

After waging war against the Norse gods and seeing Atreus off on his path, Kratos turns to face his past in the DLC ""God of War Ragnarök: Valhalla"". This statue is inspired by a moment from that story. Having accepted his own sins and bridged his past and present, the God of War of the Nine Realms appears upon the throne in 1/3 scale-an embodiment of self-mastery realized in a format made to pursue the fullest depth of three-dimensional expression.

A face framed by deep lines and a full beard carries the dignity of a warrior seasoned by the subtleties of life. Countless old scars across his skin are rendered with painstaking paintwork, capturing rough textures and profound shadows. Leather and iron armor, along with the runic patterns carved into the stone throne, evoke the rugged world of Norse myth. At his side sits his ally Mimir, reproduced with lifelike detail down to his curled beard. The light shining from both eyes via the built-in LED brings focus to the path Kratos sets his gaze upon.

Pair Master Thyself Kratos with the simultaneously released Young Kratos and explore a variety of display arrangements. This is a piece that lets you feel the past, present, and future of a man who has walked a long road.

Product Specifications:

- God of War: Ragnarok -Themed Base
- LED Illumination (Mimir's Eyes)
